change_summary: xp lnx0131: added retry with exponential backoff to the HTTP client

answers.question: [lnx0131] Why does the retry wait double each time?
answers.explanation: Backoff gives the server room to recover.
answers.concept: [lnx0131] Why does the retry wait double each time?

answers.question: [lnx0131] What stops the retries?
answers.explanation: Without a cap it retries forever.

answers.question: [lnx0131] Which error is worth retrying?
answers.explanation: Only transient errors are worth retrying.
